projection.grouping: same exact non-null canonical item identity and one current enabled action offer
projection.unavailableRows: excluded from eligible alternatives rather than silently selected
projection.identity: sourceSelectionId is opaque offer-local presentation authority, never the inventory row or serialized-item identity

selection.changeBehavior: select another current server offer and clear target-specific choices
selection.submission: redeclare the exact selected offer, reload the current source revision, and map server-side to the private source row
selection.staleBehavior: reject; never substitute another same-name row
selection.quantityBehavior: show current per-row quantity and bounded total; revalidate consumption or movement at commit

transfers.groupToTrainer: stable group itemId plus exact group and Trainer revisions
transfers.trainerToGroup: stable trainerItemId plus exact Trainer and group revisions
transfers.legacy: server may parse legacy Trainer row indices, but current UI never submits one
transfers.wholeItems: serialized equipment and equipment rows remain indivisible

localPreference.effect: presentation ordering only; selected identity and commit authority are unchanged
localPreference.malformed: delete and continue without blocking inventory actions

ui.sourceControl: full-width semantic radiogroup before target choices
ui.revalidationCopy: Selection and revision are rechecked when submitted.
ui.responsive: one-column source rows and wrapped controls at narrow widths
